summary: Samples allocated memory on device and fires when it crosses a threshold, optionally cleaning up.
overview: Periodically samples total allocated memory and fires when it crosses a limit, without the Editor profiler attached. Aimed at the failure mode a 24/7 kiosk hits: memory creeping up over a long session because nothing explicitly unloads.
useCases: An unattended build that must survive days without a restart.
Catching a leak on device that does not show in a short Editor session.
Triggering a cleanup before loading a large batch of assets.

params.tuning: Seconds. The sample itself is cheap; the cleanup it can trigger is not.
Total allocated, not just textures. Set it from a real device reading, not a guess.
Cleanup frees unreferenced assets and forces a GC, which can cause a multi-frame hitch — which is why it is not run on every check.

gotchas.title: Crossing the threshold means it is already too late to be subtle
gotchas.body: Cleanup is the blunt response. Treat a firing watchdog as a signal to find what is not being unloaded, not as the fix.
